subject: Multi-cloud listing: splitflow & edge-region launch decisions
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-cloud listing: splitflow & edge-region launch decisions

Team —

Following up from last week's GTM sync: we need a short decision record for which SKUs we surface per cloud and how we phase edge/region coverage for the Acme Analytics pilot (their contract references AWS + GCP but they have Azure eval workstreams). High level asks:

1) SKU splitflow: which product bundles map to Marketplace SKUs vs. direct offer? (e.g., Hosted API core, Dedicated reserved block, Private VPC).
2) Canary regions: pick one primary edge region per cloud (us-east-1, us-central1, westeurope?) for initial listing + canary routing to avoid cross-cloud capacity surprises.
3) Packaging differences: do we flatten pricing or keep cloud-specific SKUs/limits?
4) Contract tie-ins: procurement needs the SKU codes for MOU and ordering.

I sketched a proposed splitflow attached (first cut) and a short canary matrix — please review and flag any blockers by EOD Wednesday. If we can finalize, I will send a consolidated ask to the cloud partner teams and loop Acme for signature on the MOU.

Attachments: sku_splitflow_v2.xlsx (xlsx), regional_canary_matrix.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud listing: splitflow & edge-region launch decisions

Thanks Aditya — quick notes inline:

• SKU mapping: agree with splitting Hosted API + Dedicated as separate Marketplace SKUs. For Private we should keep as a consult/contract-only offering (no public SKU) to avoid VAR confusion.
• Region canaries: propose us-east-1 (AWS), us-central1 (GCP), and westeurope2 (Azure) — westeurope2 gives us a non-US EU canary for later EU expansion.
• Packaging: keep a single price band (standard unit) but publish cloud-specific SKU codes for ordering clarity. Avoid per-cloud price variance initially — we can gate after usage data.

I updated your sheet with SKU IDs and added a slide for procurement timing — see attached. Also flagged a potential billing API gap for Dedicated orders (Ben, FYI).

Attachments: sku_splitflow_v2.xlsx

Aditya / Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Acme prefers:

• Initial listing on AWS + GCP only (we're comfortable signing the MOU for those).
• Please include a note that EU traffic for our analysis tier must stay within EU regions — we'll target a later EU pilot window.
• For the canary region, AWS us-east-1 is fine. For GCP we prefer us-central1 as you suggested. No Azure for initial pilot.

We'll attach the signed MOU once you send the final SKU list and the MOU redlines you requested. I attached our internal partner intake form for completeness.

Attachment: acme_partner_intake_form.pdf

Best,
Lena Ortiz
CloudOps Manager
Acme Analytics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud listing: splitflow & edge-region launch decisions — DECISIONS & NEXT STEPS

All — finalizing the decision record based on the thread and Acme confirmation. Summary decisions (record for GTM/partners):

1) Pilot listing coverage: AWS + GCP only (Acme confirmed). No Azure listing for pilot; Azure listing deferred to post-pilot product/partner review.
2) SKU splitflow: publish three marketplace SKUs — Hosted API (metered), Dedicated (reserved commit), and Integration/Support bundle (consult-only, not public SKU). SKU codes are in the Drive link.
3) Canary regions: AWS -> us-east-1; GCP -> us-central1. EU pilot (westeurope2) deferred until signed ATO/processing clarifications.
4) Pricing approach: one price band across clouds; cloud-specific SKU identifiers for procurement clarity.
5) Procurement artifacts: Karthik will deliver SKU acceptance checklist; Aditya will send the MOU with Acme redlines (attach acme_mou_redlines.pdf).

Action items:
• Aditya: finalize SKU list + push to cloud partner contacts (AWS/GCP) this week.
• Karthik: deliver acceptance checklist and updated MOU terms by Fri 3/12.
• Ben: confirm billing flow for Dedicated commit vs Hosted metered by EOD Thu.

I've uploaded the consolidated decision doc + attachments to the drive link and updated the HubSpot deal record (DEAL-2027-1842). Please review and mark done on your action items.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/sku-splitflow-v2
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2027-1842

Attachments: acme_mou_redlines.pdf, regional_canary_matrix.csv
